subject: Add embed-warmup gate to held-out retrieval bench (baseline is under-measured)
description: The held-out retrieval bench (orchestrator repo at /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator, bench/retrieval/run-heldout-retrieval.sh -> scripts/retrieval-bench.js, runHeldoutEval + main) under-measures recall because it fires queries before the isolated snapshot daemon's MiniLM embed sidecar finishes lazy-loading. While cold, embed() returns null and /search silently falls back to PURE LEXICAL (every hit has via:'lexical'), so semantic scoring never runs. Evidence: locked baseline note-mqd6hrlnbhp recorded bench-metric recall@5=0.4/MRR=0.3 and task-transcript MRR=0.875, but with a WARM sidecar the true numbers are bench-metric 0.6/0.467 and task-transcript MRR=1.0 (reproducible, deterministic 3x). FIX: before the measurement loop in BOTH main() and runHeldoutEval() (right after the /ping check), poll a probe query until at least one result comes back via:'semantic' (proving the query embedding AND node vecs are live), with a ~120s budget and a WARN-on-timeout. Note scripts/retrieval-bench.js httpGetJSON has a 5s req timeout but the first embed can take up to 90s, so the warmup loop must tolerate per-attempt timeouts and retry. Then re-run run-heldout-retrieval.sh 3x to confirm determinism and RE-LOCK the corrected baseline (supersede note-mqd6hrlnbhp via record_decision supersedes). This re-baseline must happen BEFORE Step 2 (tag/category re-rank boost, task 091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee/9) so Step 2 measures against warm numbers, not the cold lexical-only artifact. Full design + measurements are in note-mqd8b3uzlos.
